name: Charred remains
notes: What wood becomes when its fire burns out (mw-e03.5): blackened, brittle charcoal. No longer flammable, so a burnt crate never reignites (its fuel is spent). Crumbles from a solid blow (fragile 150 J, a hard kick or a mace) and has lost most of its mass (density 300 kg/m³, lump charcoal about 250–600). Crunchy underfoot (+3 dB) with a hollow wooden knock. It sets no hp: fire has already worn the object's own hp down, and a preset must not restore it. Soft, crumbling surface; too brittle to hold a rope arrow. (mw-e03.31)
